GETTING STARTED
Getting Started with Dengage Knowledge Base
Dengage is a Customer Experience Data Platform (CXDP). It unifies your customer data in one place and lets you act on it: build segments, automate journeys, and reach your customers over email, SMS, push, WhatsApp, in-app, inbox and on-site channels.
This page helps you find the right guide in under a minute.
Choose your path
🎯 I run campaigns (marketing, CRM, growth)
Follow these four steps. They mirror how the platform is organized:
Connect and organize your data. Data Management covers tables, imports, exports, and automated data flows.
Know your audience. Build dynamic audiences with Profiles and Segments, using filters and logic groups.
Create and send. Design your message under Content in the left menu (Email, SMS, Push, and more), then launch it with Flow Campaigns.
Measure and improve. Track performance under Analytics: channel reports, RFM analysis, and audience insights.
👩‍💻 I'm integrating (developer)
Start with CXDP in a Nutshell to see how the APIs, SDKs, and messaging infrastructure fit together.
Follow Onboarding to set up your account, environment, and keys.
Install an SDK: Web, iOS, or Android. Guides for React Native, Flutter, Cordova, and Expo live in the same section.
Call the REST API, starting with Authorization.
Prefer watching? The Walkthrough Videos offer quick visual overviews of core features.
Stay up to date
New features and improvements ship regularly. See What's New for release notes.
Can't find what you need?
Use the search bar at the top; it covers every guide, API reference, and FAQ. For quick answers to common questions, check the FAQ section in the left menu. Still stuck? Reach out to your Customer Success Manager or our support team.
